=== PAGE 1 ===
Toronto Transit Commission
2024 Annual Report
Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024

Message from the CEO

In 2024 the TTC carried more riders than in any year since the pandemic as
service was restored across the bus, subway and streetcar network. This report
summarizes ridership, financial and fleet performance for the calendar year.

=== PAGE 2 ===
Operating and Financial Highlights (year ended December 31, 2024)

Total customer trips (ridership) ........................ 256.9 million
Conventional service revenue service hours ............... 9.85 million hours
Operating revenue (passenger fares and other) ........... $1,310.0 million
Total operating expenses ................................ $2,240.0 million
Net operating subsidy from the City of Toronto .......... $930.0 million

All financial figures are in Canadian dollars unless otherwise noted. Operating
revenue excludes municipal and provincial operating subsidies.

=== PAGE 3 ===
Fleet and Accessibility (as at December 31, 2024)

Revenue vehicle fleet (bus, subway, streetcar) .......... 2,510 vehicles
Average fleet age ....................................... 11.2 years
Accessible fleet (low-floor / elevator-equipped) ........ 98.5%

=== PAGE 4 ===
Service Performance Notes

On-time performance is reported on differing bases across modes. The subway
figure reflects scheduled headway adherence while the surface figure reflects
trips departing within the on-time window. A single blended system on-time
performance of approximately 82% is provided here as an indicative figure only;
it is not directly comparable to prior-year reporting and is subject to
restatement. Riders are encouraged to consult the modal detail tables.
